verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a catalog of native integrations described as auditor-vetted, which automatically collect compliance data to satisfy evidence requests and power monitors. Its help center names connected cloud systems (AWS, Azure, GCP) checked by monitors, and its IP-allowlisting doc implies a real data-pull architecture. The evidence names only cloud providers and never addresses permission scopes. missing for 10: documented coverage of identity, HR, code hosting, MDM and ticketing integrations; any documentation of read-only scopes or least-privilege permissions; a per-integration setup catalog; independent or hands-on corroboration.
